before: Compose wrote a pending table or cell record back as the file's change record when it was the one record drawn, also after a column made since the load had changed the record's original (a lent width, a grid with the new column): live wrote the original the load read, while the pending view and the next fold hold the changed one.
after: The file's record is written back only when nothing made later changed its original.
reason: Change messages, the change log, checkpoints and the Yjs format do not change; compose draws the table as the editor does, the same on every copy. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
